summary: Frontend-only verification of Self-Check placement/copy and result screen changes. All requested scenarios pass: section order (SelfCheck above Recognition), bilingual intro (heading, body, 3 benefits, disclaimer, single Start button showing BOTH 'Start Self-Check' and 'सेल्फ़-चेक शुरू करें'), Start -> Track -> 8 Questions -> Result flow, HIGH band on all opt-3 answers shows result-helpline + 3 numbered next steps + Call/WhatsApp/Book icon buttons, LOW band on all opt-0 answers hides helpline, lead submit (POST /api/leads) returns success and shows result-thanks, and Hindi lang-toggle translates intro heading/body/benefits/start-button and result content (including next-steps) into Hindi with the bilingual Start button flipping order (Hindi primary + English secondary).
action_items: Minor: The review request references [data-testid='testimonial-stack'] but Testimonials.jsx passes testId='testimonial' to SwipeStack, so the actual DOM testid is 'testimonial' (and card is 'testimonial-card'). If the intended contract is 'testimonial-stack', update Testimonials.jsx accordingly. Not a blocker – testimonials section still renders and swipes.
critical_code_review_comments: SelfCheck.jsx is ~527 lines and mixes intro/track/question/result stages + lead form in one component. Consider splitting into sub-components (SelfCheckIntro, SelfCheckTrack, SelfCheckQuestion, SelfCheckResult) for maintainability – >500 line threshold.
Bilingual Start button uses CONTENT[lang === 'en' ? 'hi' : 'en'] inline – works, but the small secondary label uses text-sand/70 on teal which is readable; verify contrast on real devices.

Restart button in result stage only appears in the 'submitted' branch (thanks view). If a user reaches result but does NOT submit lead, there is no visible 'restart' control other than the browser back / re-answering. Consider adding a subtle 'Retake' link in the pre-submit result view as well.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_User lead submitted via /api/leads during HIGH-band flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Self-Check placement, bilingual intro, HIGH/LOW banding, next-steps rendering, booking icon buttons, lead submit, and Hindi language toggle work end-to-end on the production preview URL. Only nit is testimonial testId naming ('testimonial' vs expected 'testimonial-stack').
